findings.body:
Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#契约与 API 规范（契约单一源·决策 #6；不在 content-api 内重定义契约）
Note: The revision target-kind vocabulary that appears in AdminDraftReviseResponse/AdminDraftUpdateResponse is re-declared locally as a hand-written string union (and mirrored again in model.ts as `as 'blog' | 'faq' | 'changelog' | 'model' | 'family'`). Contract shapes are supposed to come from @hiapi/content-sdk as the single source rather than be restated inside content-api.

findings.body:
Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#软删除铁律（dbUnscoped() 是唯一绕过通道: … raw 操作 …）
Note: Raw SQL is issued through the transaction client obtained from db() (see also lockTarget's i18n lock and the `Prisma.raw(...)` table identifiers), bypassing the scoped-client filtering without going through dbUnscoped(), which the spec names as the only channel for raw operations.

notes: The companion CLI work is stated to live in another repository (hiapi-cli PR #18) and is therefore not verifiable from this diff; only the server/SDK contract and documentation are present here.

All verification numbers (571 tests, 18 route-guard tests, typecheck, ESLint, migration replay) are author assertions in the PR body and task docs; no CI logs or job output were supplied with this request, so the claim about the corrected remote run 44669467061 cannot be confirmed from the diff alone.

Behavioral nuance worth flagging in review: ordinary (non-revision) acceptance of blog/faq/model-faq/changelog/model-info now also writes an `ingest_draft_acceptance` row and calls `revisionKind(draft)` inside the accept transaction, which additionally validates content-type mapping for every such accept.

Revision acceptance of blog content triggers a post-commit `purgeBlogPages(result.entityId, [draft.locale])`; this cache invalidation is described in the updated transcriber guidelines but not in the PR body.
The version precondition is mandatory only for Showcase edits and revision candidates; other PATCH targets remain unguarded unless the caller supplies `expectedUpdatedAt`.
